question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts added the Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act**, enacted in **1976**.
 
• This amendment incorporated **Article 51A** under Part IV-A of the Constitution, outlining 10 Fundamental Duties for citizens.
 
• The amendment was introduced during the tenure of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi** as part of efforts to strengthen democracy.
 
• The Fundamental Duties were inspired by the Constitution of the former Soviet Union, aiming to promote responsible citizenship and national unity.
 
• The list of duties was later expanded to 11 by the **86th Amendment Act** in 2002, which added the duty to provide opportunities for education to children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties:**

 
 
• Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced through courts.
 
• They serve as moral obligations for citizens to uphold the spirit of the Constitution and contribute to the nation.
 
 
 
• **42nd Amendment Act:**
 
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act is often referred to as the **"Mini Constitution"** because of the extensive changes it brought.
 
• It amended several articles, including the Preamble, and introduced concepts like the primacy of Directive Principles over Fundamental Rights.
 
 
 
• **Part IV-A of the Constitution:**
 
 
• Part IV-A was introduced solely to include Fundamental Duties.
 
• It emphasizes duties such as respecting the national symbols, safeguarding public property, and promoting harmony.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A:**
 
 
• Article 51A lists duties like abiding by the Constitution, protecting sovereignty, and preserving the environment.
 
• The duties are applicable to all citizens of India, irrespective of age or profession.
